text: Simple illustration of A sublime and epic piece of high-fantasy landscape illustration. A massive, primordial temple, crafted from dark, ancient rock, rises dramatically out of a misty, rugged valley. The architecture is impossibly grand, featuring multiple towering spires and intricately carved facades, suggesting untold age. The structure is bathed in a magical, vibrant cyan energy that seems to emanate from its core, lighting up the surrounding mist. The sky above is a dramatic clash of deep indigo and fiery orange, creating a sense of impending storm and magical power. The overall mood is one of awe and homecoming. Style: Fantasy Concept Art, incredibly rich color grading, atmospheric and majestic.
